text:
alex: Heads-up — proposing a phased 'splay' unpin for runtime v3.2 next week. Goal is to avoid a big sticky-pin wave and give SDK/Model teams time to adjust. planning window 03/25 02:00-04:00 UTC.

maya: splay? can you summarize the phases quickly?

alex: Phase 0: dry-run telemetry + small canary (5% of traffic) for group A models. Phase 1: widen to 25% if no regressions, Phase 2: full unpin. rollback criteria are latency+error SLOs + eval regressions.

jordan: which models are group A vs B?

alex: group A = llama3q-*, quant-v4b variants; group B = gpt3a/gptx2 families. group A has the KV-cache kink we saw last month so we want a slower ramp.

sam: EU region has nightly long-seq batch jobs 02:30-03:30 UTC. Can we exclude EU from Phase 1?

alex: good catch — yes, exclude eu-west for Phase 1. we'll route eu-west to pinned v3.1 until Phase 2.

priya: telemetry note: longseq tail latency on v3.1 is ~1200ms P99 for quant-v4b under nightly batch, v3.2 looks better in short tests but we need more stable canary. recommend doubling the canary duration for group A.

alex: agree. update: Phase 0 -> 6h canary, Phase 1 -> 48h widen. if any of these triggers (P95 latency +15% OR error rate >0.5%) we rollback to pinned runtime and notify.

maya: what's the exact fallback rule so deploybot can wire it?

alex: routing rule (high level):
```json
{
  "routing_policy": "splay-unpin",
  "groups": {"A": {"fallback": "runtime-v3.1", "canary_pct": 5}, "B": {"fallback": "runtime-v3.1", "canary_pct": 25}},
  "timeouts_ms": 1200
}
```

jordan: @deploy-bot can you preflight for model-group mappings and produce a diff of pinlist changes?

deploy-bot: preflight started for thread 7112233445. scanning pinlists...
deploy-bot: found 12 pin entries affecting group A models; proposed actions: set unpin-window 2026-03-25T02:00Z-04:00Z for canary cohort, exclude eu-west during Phase 1.

deploy-bot: healthcheck script attached -> `/opt/deploy/checks/runtime_canary_health.sh` (exit code summary due in 3m).

sam: If healthcheck flags anything, do we auto-rollback or alert only?

alex: Auto-rollback for error-rate spike >0.5% within any 30m window. Latency regressions alert first, then 1-hour hold for manual review before rollback.

priya: I'll add eval prompts for quality regression on quant-v4b. timeline: create evals by EOD today.

maya: pinging SDK team — some SDK clients pin low-level ABI; need to verify compatibility with runtime v3.2. @jordan can you confirm SDK shim readiness?

jordan: SDK shim v2.7 has the runtime negotiation fix; I verified canary in staging. I'll compile a compatibility note in the release doc.

alex: action items: 1) @deploy-bot run preflight and attach diff (deploy-bot done). 2) @priya add evals (ETA EOD). 3) @jordan release SDK compatibility blurb. 4) @sam coordinate EU exclusion for Phase 1. We'll reconvene on this thread with deploy-bot health outputs. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: preflight complete. proposed pinlist diff uploaded to https://redwood-internal/repo/pin-diffs/7112233445.diff
deploy-bot: scheduling unpin job (canary) for 2026-03-25T02:00Z. status: queued.

sam: ack, I updated the EU routing entry to keep pins until 2026-03-26T00:00Z.

alex: thanks everyone — i'll mark this as the source of truth for the plan. please post any late concerns here. :eyes:
